task_completion.description: Agent captures a wide-field sky view or star map of the target area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot showing a sky map, planetarium view, or a wide-field image of the Ursa Major region around M82.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target is M82 (Cigar Galaxy). Coordinates: RA 9.9311h (approx 09h 55m 52s), Dec +69.6797° (approx +69° 40' 47"). Required filters and slots: L (Slot 1), G (Slot 2), B (Slot 3), R (Slot 4), and Ha. The agent must follow the specific binning and exposure times listed in ~/Documents/m82_imaging_plan.txt. A coordinate tolerance of 15 arcminutes is acceptable.
